title: Framework configuration
description: The versioned configuration contract required by FR-24. It separates eight concerns so that environment settings can vary while the workload definition does not (FR-36). No section may hold an inline secret: sensitive values are referenced through externalReferences and never carried here (SEC-013).

evidenceRetentionDays.description: Retention is bounded below by 1: a retention of zero would discard the evidence that every conclusion must resolve to.

subscriptionRef.description: Names an entry in externalReferences. A subscription identifier is never written inline, because a committed configuration would then carry an environment identifier (SEC-013, NFR-02).

extensionRef.description: Names a workload extension. The core declares the seam; it ships no workload-type content of its own (FR-63, CON-11).

inScope.description: An empty in-scope selection is rejected structurally by minItems as well as semantically, because a configuration that selects nothing would otherwise validate and deploy an agent that observes nothing (FR-28).

toolPolicyRef.description: Names the tool policy that applies. The policy is defence in depth: the read-only guarantee derives from the RBAC grant, which Azure Resource Manager enforces, not from this declaration (SEC-001).

evidenceRequired.description: When true, a conclusion that resolves to no evidence entry is a validation failure rather than a warning.

mode.description: v1 admits no mutating mode. A value that permits mutation is absent from the contract rather than merely discouraged, so a configuration cannot request one and be silently downgraded.

selfApprovalPermitted.description: Fixed false in v1. Self-approval would let a single principal both propose and authorise, which is the separation the approval ledger exists to record.

entries.description: Indirection only. Each entry names where a value lives; none carries the value. A property shaped like a secret is absent from this schema rather than validated, so an inline secret cannot be expressed at all (SEC-013).

locator.description: Where the value lives, never the value. A locator must not be a literal credential; the emitted artifact is committed by consumers.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this schema the instance conforms to (FR-05, FR-29). A consumer pinned to version N keeps validating unchanged when N+1 ships (CC-C01). Pinned with const rather than left to the pattern: without it an instance could declare any version at all and still validate, which made the declaration decorative (NFR-21).

identifier.description: Lowercase, hyphen-separated. Constrained so an identifier cannot carry arbitrary text, and English by construction (FR-03, CON-01).

externalReferenceName.description: Names an entry in externalReferences. Resolution that the named entry exists is a semantic check, not a structural one.

observationPeriod.description: An end that precedes its start is rejected by a semantic check; JSON Schema cannot compare two sibling values (FR-28).

kind.description: Selection mechanism, deliberately not a workload type. The minimal example must stay workload-neutral (FR-63, CC-022).

selector.description: A placeholder in every shipped example. A literal resource identifier here would be an environment identifier in a committed file.
